When we later started discussing our wedding packages, we mentioned that last time we didn’t ask for a discount but expected one this time. At that point, he began arguing, saying that he had given us a fair price and package last time, and went on about how busy he was and the number of shoots he had on our engagement day. We had only asked for a good discount this time, but he started justifying the packages he gave us last time instead of focusing on our wedding package that we asked him for.
Like this is way you talk to you client l??
Don't tell us how much work quantity you have show us your quality work
Just because you have so many shoots so client has to tell you 100 times that how they need their photo and videos
